standard_prerequisites.use: Statement lines 1711-1714 and proof lines 1721-1723: the functors g_{n!} and their description from the restriction lemma, used without further mention.

standard_prerequisites.name: The free abelian sheaf on a simplicial set and homotopy invariance
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 1730-1749: g_m^{-1} of the complex is the free abelian sheaf on Delta[m]; Delta[m] is homotopy equivalent to Delta[0] and taking free abelian sheaves is functorial.

core_obligations: The complex and its differentials (proof lines 1723-1729): the maps are sum (-1)^i d^n_i with d^n_i : g_{n!}Z -> g_{n-1!}Z adjoint to the map Z -> (direct sum over [n-1] -> [n] of) Z = g_n^{-1}g_{n-1!}Z labeled by the face delta^n_i : [n-1] -> [n].

The g_m^{-1} image (lines 1729-1736): applying g_m^{-1} gives the direct-sum complex over Mor_Delta([n],[m]) of copies of Z on C_m, i.e. the complex associated to the free abelian sheaf on the simplicial set Delta[m].

Acyclicity (lines 1736-1749): Delta[m] is homotopy equivalent to Delta[0]; taking free abelian sheaves is functorial, so the complex is homotopy equivalent to the free abelian sheaf on Delta[0], which is acyclic in positive degrees and equal to Z in degree 0; hence the complex resolves the constant sheaf Z on C_total.
proof_roadmap: Define the differentials as the adjoints of the face maps.
Apply g_m^{-1} to identify the complex with the free abelian sheaf on Delta[m].
Transfer the homotopy equivalence Delta[m] simeq Delta[0] through the free-sheaf functor to conclude acyclicity.
difficulty_reason: Resolution lemma (statement 1710-1719, proof 1721-1749): the constant-sheaf twin of the ringed resolution card L46181 - alternating-sum differentials, the g_m^{-1} image identified with the free abelian sheaf on Delta[m], acyclicity by transporting the homotopy equivalence Delta[m] simeq Delta[0] through the free-sheaf functor; no verification is omitted. H2: standard simplicial resolution.
